articles.title: Bitcoin’s dormant supply rises, a behavior seen during previous bear-market bottoming phases
articles.snippet: More bitcoin is sitting untouched onchain as the price holds around $60,000, some 50% below its peak,

articles.title: Over 1,000 Bitcoin miners were tricked into working for a thief by a fake internet route
articles.snippet: An attacker steered up to 1.9 EH/s of mining power to an impostor pool earlier in November using a weakness most of the industry's largest pools still carry.

articles.title: Bill to lock up U.S. government bitcoin for 20 years advances to full House
articles.snippet: A bill to codify Trump’s Strategic Bitcoin Reserve has cleared committee and is eligible for a House vote, but it faces a tight deadline.

articles.title: Zcash devs urge users to migrate 2% of ZEC supply to accelerate Sapling pool retirement
articles.snippet: Zcash developers urged users to move funds out of an older shielded transaction pool over concerns that AI advances could compromise its cryptography.

articles.title: Switzerland’s first spot Bitcoin ETF ticks up 0.6% in opening hour
articles.snippet: The spot Bitcoin ETF will be backed by Bitcoin held in cold storage at a Swiss bank, unlike prior Bitcoin ETPs structured as debt securities.
